title: Learn: rules and alarms
description: Open lesson 3 of Learn, preview a temperature threshold on a simulated amplifier over its real samples, then unplug it and watch the reachability rule open an alarm in the lesson.

steps.caption: Lesson 3 of Learn walks a simulated amplifier from samples to an alarm.
A rule reads one metric. Pick its temperature.
Say when it is bad, above 35 degrees.
Preview runs it over the last day of real samples, writing nothing.
What the rule would hold in force now, and the edges it would have written.
Now trip a shipped rule for real, on the simulated amplifier.
Unplug it, as if its cable were pulled.
Save. The simulator applies it on its next pull.
The lesson lists the amplifier's alarms as they land.
The down held past its 15 second sustain, so reachability-lost opened an alarm, live.
